description: Eight new Roslyn-based refactoring and analysis commands: find-callers, list-smells, extract-interface, fix-namespace, add-dependency, find-unused, extract-class, make-async. Ordered by complexity — read-only first, mutation last.
ralph_instructions:
Work through userStories in priority order. For each story where passes=false: follow the TDD phase indicated in the story notes. Verification uses `dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx` and `dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal` (use .sln for tests — MSBuildWorkspace does not support .slnx).

TDD DISCIPLINE:
- BASELINE: all tests green before any change
- RED: tests compile and fail for the right reason (missing command / NotImplementedException), NOT compilation errors
- GREEN: minimal code to pass — 100% line coverage on new code
- REFACTOR: tests stay green, no behavior change

File layout for each new command:
- src/RoslynTools/Commands/XxxCommand.cs — CLI definition, options, SetHandler
- src/RoslynTools/Core/XxxCore.cs (or inline in command for small commands) — Roslyn logic
- tests/RoslynTools.Tests/XxxTests.cs — xUnit tests with [Collection("MSBuild")]
- Register in src/RoslynTools/App.cs with alias

userStories.title: Write find-callers tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the find-callers command contract so the implementation is verifiable.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all existing tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/FindCallersTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder with: class Greeter { public string Greet(string name) => ...; } and class Program { void Run() { var g = new Greeter(); g.Greet("Alice"); g.Greet("Bob"); } }
Test: FindCallers_ReturnsInvocationSites — Greet has 2 callers in Run, assert 2 results with correct file/line/containingMethod
Test: FindCallers_ExcludesNonInvocationReferences — nameof(Greet) or type references not returned
Test: FindCallers_ZeroCallers_ReturnsEmpty — method with no callers returns empty list
Test: FindCallers_OverloadedMethod_DisambiguatesBySignature — two overloads, only call sites for the specified one returned
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/FindCallersCommand.cs with Build() returning a Command that throws NotImplementedException in its handler
Register stub in src/RoslynTools/App.cs so it compiles
All tests COMPILE and RUN
FindCallersTests FAIL on NotImplementedException — NOT on missing type or compilation error
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. Stub handler must compile and throw NotImplementedException so tests fail on assertion, not missing type.

userStories.title: Implement find-callers command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want find-callers to return only method invocation sites so I can assess impact before changing a signature.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt find-callers --symbol <name> [--solution <path>] [--include-tests]
Alias: callers
Use SymbolLocator to find the method symbol; disambiguate interactively if multiple matches
Use SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync; filter to InvocationExpressionSyntax nodes only (not nameof, type references)
By default exclude documents from projects whose name contains 'Test' (--include-tests overrides)
Output per result: file path, 1-based line number, containing method name, source line text (trimmed)
Output to stdout as plain text; progress to stderr
ALL FindCallersTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Use SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync (same as FindRefsCommand) then filter reference locations to InvocationExpressionSyntax parent nodes.

userStories.title: Write list-smells tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the list-smells command contract.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/ListSmellsTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder with: a class > 300 lines, a method > 40 lines, a constructor with 8 parameters
Test: ListSmells_LargeClass_Reported — class with 310 lines flagged as LargeClass
Test: ListSmells_LongMethod_Reported — method with 45 lines flagged as LongMethod
Test: ListSmells_TooManyDependencies_Reported — constructor with 8 params flagged as TooManyDependencies
Test: ListSmells_CleanProject_ReturnsEmpty — project within all thresholds returns zero results
Test: ListSmells_CustomThresholds_Respected — --max-class-lines 50 flags smaller class
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/ListSmellsCommand.cs with Build() throwing NotImplementedException
Register stub in App.cs
All tests COMPILE and RUN; ListSmellsTests FAIL on NotImplementedException
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. Stub must compile. Line-count smell requires counting lines in the syntax tree span, not file lines.

userStories.title: Implement list-smells command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a report of oversized classes, long methods, and over-injected constructors.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt list-smells [--solution <path>] [--max-class-lines <n>] [--max-method-lines <n>] [--max-params <n>] [--scope <prefix>]
Alias: smells
Defaults: max-class-lines=300, max-method-lines=40, max-params=7
LargeClass: types where (endLine - startLine + 1) > threshold
LongMethod: methods/constructors where span line count > threshold
TooManyDependencies: constructors with parameter count > threshold
Each result includes: smell type, name, file path, line number, actual count
--scope filters to projects/namespaces matching the prefix
Read-only — no --dry-run needed
Output to stdout as plain text; progress (project names) to stderr
ALL ListSmellsTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Walk all documents via GetSyntaxRootAsync, find ClassDeclarationSyntax/MethodDeclarationSyntax/ConstructorDeclarationSyntax, compute line spans.

userStories.title: Write extract-interface tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the extract-interface command contract.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/ExtractInterfaceTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder with a service class: public class AgentService { public string GetAgent(int id) {} public void DeleteAgent(int id) {} private void Helper() {} }
Test: ExtractInterface_CreatesInterfaceFile — IAgentService.cs created alongside AgentService.cs
Test: ExtractInterface_InterfaceContainsPublicMembersOnly — GetAgent and DeleteAgent present; Helper absent
Test: ExtractInterface_ClassUpdatedToImplementInterface — AgentService declaration includes ': IAgentService'
Test: ExtractInterface_DryRun_NoFileWritten — --dry-run prints diff but does not create file
Test: ExtractInterface_ClassAlreadyImplementsInterface_AppendsCorrectly — class already has ': IOther', becomes ': IOther, IAgentService'
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/ExtractInterfaceCommand.cs throwing NotImplementedException
Register stub in App.cs
All tests COMPILE and RUN; ExtractInterfaceTests FAIL on NotImplementedException
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. This command creates a new file — SolutionWriter.ApplyChangesAsync now supports GetAddedDocuments() (US-006 from cleanup pass).

userStories.title: Implement extract-interface command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to generate a matching interface from a class's public members.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt extract-interface --type <name> [--solution <path>] [--output-dir <dir>] [--namespace <ns>] [--dry-run]
Alias: ei
Interface name: I + ClassName (e.g. AgentService -> IAgentService)
Interface contains all public methods and properties (no fields, no private/internal/protected)
Interface file placed alongside the class file (or --output-dir if supplied)
Interface namespace matches class namespace (or --namespace override)
Class declaration updated to implement the new interface (appended if already implementing others)
Uses SolutionWriter.ApplyChangesAsync with the modified solution (class update + new interface doc)
--dry-run shows unified diff for class file and +++ header for new interface file
ALL ExtractInterfaceTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Use DocumentEditor to modify the class declaration. Build interface text via SyntaxFactory. New file added to solution via project.AddDocument() then SolutionWriter handles the write.

userStories.title: Write fix-namespace tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the fix-namespace command contract.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/FixNamespaceTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder — place a file in a subdirectory with a mismatched namespace
Test: FixNamespace_UpdatesDeclarationToMatchPath — namespace in file updated to match folder structure
Test: FixNamespace_UpdatesReferencingFiles_UsingStatements — other files referencing old namespace get their using updated
Test: FixNamespace_AlreadyCorrect_NoOp — file already has correct namespace, no changes made, message printed
Test: FixNamespace_DryRun_NoWrites — --dry-run prints diff but does not write
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/FixNamespaceCommand.cs throwing NotImplementedException
Register stub in App.cs
All tests COMPILE and RUN; FixNamespaceTests FAIL on NotImplementedException
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. Target namespace is derived from the file path relative to the project root, substituting path separators with dots and prepending the project's root namespace.

userStories.title: Implement fix-namespace command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to fix a file's namespace to match its folder structure.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt fix-namespace --file <path> [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: fns
Compute expected namespace: file path relative to project root, replace path separators with '.', prepend project RootNamespace (from .csproj AssemblyName or project name)
If namespace already matches: print 'Namespace already correct.' and exit 0
Update the namespace declaration in the target file
Update using statements in all other files that reference the old namespace (reuse MoveCommand's namespace-rewriting logic — extract shared helper if needed)
--dry-run prints unified diff; no writes
ALL FixNamespaceTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Reuse/adapt the namespace-rewriting CSharpSyntaxRewriter from MoveCommand rather than reimplementing.

userStories.title: Write add-dependency tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the add-dependency command contract.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/AddDependencyTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder with: class AgentService with existing constructor, and a class with no constructor
Test: AddDependency_AddsFieldAndCtorParam — field 'private readonly IEmailService _emailService' added, ctor param added, assignment added
Test: AddDependency_FieldNameDerivedByConvention — IEmailService -> _emailService (strip I, camelCase)
Test: AddDependency_CustomFieldName — --field _mailer overrides convention
Test: AddDependency_NoConstructor_GeneratesOne — class with no ctor gets a new constructor
Test: AddDependency_DryRun_NoWrites — --dry-run prints diff but does not write
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/AddDependencyCommand.cs throwing NotImplementedException
Register stub in App.cs
All tests COMPILE and RUN; AddDependencyTests FAIL on NotImplementedException
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. The ConstructorInjector class in ReplaceTypeCommand.cs is the primary reuse target — generalize it.

userStories.title: Implement add-dependency command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add a constructor dependency to a class without hand-editing constructor signatures.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt add-dependency --type <ClassName> --dependency <ITypeName> [--field <fieldName>] [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: ad
Field name auto-derived: strip leading I from interface name, camelCase, prefix _ (IEmailService -> _emailService)
Adds 'private readonly <ITypeName> <fieldName>;' field after existing fields
Adds '<ITypeName> <paramName>' parameter to primary constructor (last position)
Adds '<fieldName> = <paramName>;' assignment as first statement in constructor body
If class has no constructor: generates one
Partial class support: locate the file containing the constructor (not just any partial file)
Adds missing using directive if the dependency type's namespace is known
--dry-run prints unified diff; no writes
Reuse/generalize ConstructorInjector from ReplaceTypeCommand.cs
ALL AddDependencyTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Extract and generalize ConstructorInjector from ReplaceTypeCommand — parameterize the field name, type name, param name. Reuse EnsureUsing helper too.

userStories.title: Write find-unused tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the find-unused command contract.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/FindUnusedTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder with: a class with one referenced method and one unreferenced method, a serialization-attributed type [Serializable]
Test: FindUnused_ReportsUnreferencedMethod — unreferenced method appears in results
Test: FindUnused_DoesNotReportReferencedMethod — referenced method absent from results
Test: FindUnused_ExcludesSerializationAttributedTypes — [Serializable] class not reported
Test: FindUnused_ScopeTypes_OnlyReportsTypes — --scope types only returns types, not methods
Test: FindUnused_ScopeMethods_OnlyReportsMethods — --scope methods only returns methods
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/FindUnusedCommand.cs throwing NotImplementedException
Register stub in App.cs
All tests COMPILE and RUN; FindUnusedTests FAIL on NotImplementedException
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. find-unused must load all documents cross-project to count references — similar to FindRefsCommand but inverted (looking for zero-reference symbols).

userStories.title: Implement find-unused command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to find types and methods with no references so I can safely delete dead code.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt find-unused [--solution <path>] [--scope types|methods|all]
Alias: unused
Default scope: all
For each public/internal named type and non-interface method: use SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync and count reference locations

Exclude: entry points (Main/top-level), types with [Serializable]/[DataContract]/[JsonObject]/[JsonConverter] attributes, xUnit test classes ([Fact]/[Theory] methods and their containing types), interface members
Report: zero-reference symbols with name, kind (type/method), file, line
Progress (project name) to stderr
Read-only — no --dry-run needed
ALL FindUnusedTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. May be slow on large solutions — report project progress to stderr. Use SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync per symbol.

userStories.title: Write extract-class tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the extract-class command contract.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/ExtractClassTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder with a BigService class containing: a field, two methods
Test: ExtractClass_CreatesNewFile — FooHelper.cs created when extracting specified members
Test: ExtractClass_MovedMembersAbsentFromSource — extracted members no longer in BigService
Test: ExtractClass_SourceReceivesInjectedField — BigService gets private readonly FooHelper _fooHelper field + ctor injection
Test: ExtractClass_StaticFlag_NoInjection — --static creates a static class with static methods, no injection
Test: ExtractClass_MemberNotFound_ReportsError — unknown member name exits non-zero with error message
Test: ExtractClass_DryRun_NoWrites — --dry-run shows diff for both files, creates nothing
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/ExtractClassCommand.cs throwing NotImplementedException
Register stub in App.cs
All tests COMPILE and RUN; ExtractClassTests FAIL on NotImplementedException
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. extract-class is the most structurally complex new command — it creates a new file AND modifies the source class.

userStories.title: Implement extract-class command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to move a named group of members from a class into a new class file.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt extract-class --type <ClassName> --members <m1,m2,...> --new-type <NewName> [--static] [--solution <path>] [--output-dir <dir>] [--dry-run]
Alias: ec
Locate named members in source class; error with clear message if any not found
Build new class file: same namespace, members moved verbatim
Without --static: add private readonly field + ctor injection to source class (reuse add-dependency logic)
With --static: new class is static, members become static, no injection added
Remove extracted members from source class
New file placed alongside source (or --output-dir)
--dry-run: show unified diff for source, +++ header for new file, no writes
ALL ExtractClassTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Reuse AddDependencyCommand's constructor injection logic for the non-static path. Use DocumentEditor for removing members from source class.

userStories.title: Write make-async tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the make-async command contract.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/MakeAsyncTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder with LangVersion=7.3 fixture to catch C#8+ leakage
Test: MakeAsync_VoidBecomesTask — void method becomes async Task
Test: MakeAsync_ReturnTypeWrapped — string method becomes async Task<string>
Test: MakeAsync_MethodRenamedWithAsync — method renamed GetAgentAsync unless --no-rename
Test: MakeAsync_DirectCallerUpdated_AwaitAdded — direct caller gets await before the call
Test: MakeAsync_CallerNotAsync_MadeAsync — non-async caller made async and return type updated
Test: MakeAsync_AlreadyAsync_NoOp — already async method returns without changes
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/MakeAsyncCommand.cs throwing NotImplementedException
Register stub in App.cs
All tests COMPILE and RUN; MakeAsyncTests FAIL on NotImplementedException
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. Fixture must use LangVersion 7.3 to verify no C#8+ syntax leaks into generated output. make-async is the most complex command — direct callers only, no transitive walk.

userStories.title: Implement make-async command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to convert a synchronous method to async Task<T> and have direct callers updated.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt make-async --type <ClassName> --method <MethodName> [--no-rename] [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: ma
Return type: void -> Task, T -> Task<T>
Method renamed to <MethodName>Async unless --no-rename supplied
Add async keyword to method
Direct callers only (one level): each invocation site gets await before the call; if calling method is not already async, mark it async and update its return type
No transitive propagation — stop after direct callers
If method is already async: print message and exit 0 (no-op)
C# 7.x compatible output — no ValueTask, no IAsyncEnumerable
--dry-run shows unified diff across all affected files; no writes
ALL MakeAsyncTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Use SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync to find direct callers. CSharpSyntaxRewriter for AST transforms. Test with LangVersion 7.3 fixture to catch C#8+ leakage.
